project.name: sai-satcharitra-reader
project.description: 100% offline daily devotional reader for Sri Sai Satcharitra with Solfeggio chime synthesizer, streak tracking, and 7-day Saptah Parayan schedule.

layers.name: Presentation & UI
layers.description: HTML markup and responsive Holy Book parchment design system

layers.name: Application Logic
layers.description: Client state, bookmarks, streak tracking, and Web Audio synthesis

layers.name: Data & Content
layers.description: Structured JSON chapters, offline JS bundle, and devotional texts

layers.name: Tooling & CI/CD
layers.description: Web scraper, GitHub Actions release pipeline, and desktop packaging

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Main responsive interface containing the header, theme/font controls, daily assignment card, reading view, Saptah Parayan tab, and keyboard shortcuts modal.

nodes.name: style.css
nodes.summary: Holy book typography system with 3 switchable color themes (Holy Sepia, Light Day, Dark Night), drop caps, responsive split sidebars, and clean reading margins.

nodes.name: app.js
nodes.summary: Core client-side controller managing chapter navigation, Solfeggio frequency temple bell chime, reading streak calculation, search highlighting, and localStorage bookmarks.

nodes.name: playTempleBell
nodes.summary: Synthesizes an authentic temple bell using the Web Audio API with a 528 Hz Solfeggio fundamental tone and harmonic overtone decay without any external audio files.

nodes.name: renderDailyAssignment
nodes.summary: Calculates today's assigned chapter based on calendar day-of-year, computes estimated reading time, and displays daily devotional blessing vachans.

nodes.name: loadChapter
nodes.summary: Renders selected chapter paragraphs with drop-caps, restores previous scroll position from localStorage, and updates the overall completion progress bar.

nodes.name: updateStreak
nodes.summary: Tracks consecutive daily reading activity, increments reading streaks, and persists completion history in localStorage.

nodes.name: searchInChapter
nodes.summary: Performs instant in-reader keyword search with real-time DOM text highlighting and match navigation.

nodes.name: bundle.js
nodes.summary: Encapsulates the complete 48 reading sections and 51 chapters into a global window.SAI_CHAPTERS object to bypass desktop webview file:// CORS restrictions.

nodes.name: chapters.json
nodes.summary: 638 KB structured dataset containing full text, titles, subtitles, and paragraphs for all 51 chapters of Sri Sai Satcharitra.

nodes.name: devotional.json
nodes.summary: Curated database of the 11 Baba Promises (Vachans) and 4 daily Aarti lyrics (Kakad, Madhyan, Dhoop, Shej).

nodes.name: download_all.py
nodes.summary: Multithreaded Python scraper that fetched, parsed, sanitized, and structured all chapters from shirdibooks.com.

nodes.name: build-dmg.yml
nodes.summary: Continuous Integration workflow on GitHub Actions that compiles the native Apple Silicon .dmg installer with Pake and publishes releases.

edges.description: Applies typography and visual parchment theme styling to the HTML UI shell
Loads all 51 chapters and devotional data into window.SAI_CHAPTERS before controller execution
Loads and initializes the main client application controller script
Reads structured chapters and aarti lyrics from the bundled global object
Triggers the Web Audio harmonic 528Hz Solfeggio synthesizer chime on chapter load
Calculates and renders today's assigned reading section and holy vachan
Renders chapter paragraphs and restores saved scroll position from localStorage
Tracks and persists daily consecutive reading activity in localStorage
Filters chapter paragraphs and highlights matching keywords in real time
Saves sanitized, structured scraped text into JSON dataset
Packaged into browser-ready window script object to avoid CORS blocks
Instructs Pake to package the web shell into a native macOS Apple Silicon installer

tour.title: 1. Authentic Content Dataset
tour.description: The raw 638 KB structured JSON representing all 51 chapters and 48 daily reading sections.

tour.title: 2. Zero-CORS Offline Bundle
tour.description: To allow WebViews and local file:// browsing to run without CORS security blocks, the data is attached to window.SAI_CHAPTERS.

tour.title: 3. The Reading Shell
tour.description: Clean semantic HTML providing header controls, reading view, streak counters, and shortcuts.

tour.title: 4. Web Audio Synthesizer
tour.description: Synthesizes a 528Hz Solfeggio temple bell harmonically using pure math and zero external audio files.

tour.title: 5. Automated macOS Build
tour.description: Compiles the app into a native Apple Silicon .dmg installer with custom Shirdi Sai Baba dock icon.
